# netbird_agent_network_policy (Resource)

Manage Agent Network policies (access control + spend/token limits), see [NetBird Docs](https://docs.netbird.io/api/resources/agent-network) for more information.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbird_agent_network_policy" "engineering" {
  name        = "Engineering → OpenAI"
  description = "Allow engineers to call OpenAI with a monthly token budget."
  enabled     = true

  source_groups            = [netbird_group.engineering.id]
  destination_provider_ids = [netbird_agent_network_provider.openai.id]
  guardrail_ids            = [netbird_agent_network_guardrail.strict.id]

  token_limit = {
    enabled        = true
    group_cap      = 50000000
    user_cap       = 5000000
    window_seconds = 2592000
  }

  budget_limit = {
    enabled        = true
    group_cap_usd  = 500.0
    user_cap_usd   = 50.0
    window_seconds = 2592000
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_provider_ids` (List of String) Agent Network provider IDs the source groups can reach. Must contain at least one non-empty provider ID.
- `name` (String) Display name for the policy
- `source_groups` (List of String) NetBird group IDs whose members may call the destination providers. Must contain at least one non-empty group ID.

### Optional

- `budget_limit` (Attributes) Per-policy USD spend cap (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budget_limit))
- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled
- `guardrail_ids` (List of String) Agent Network guardrail IDs attached to this policy
- `token_limit` (Attributes) Per-policy token cap (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_limit))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Policy ID

<a id="nestedatt--budget_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budget_limit`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the budget limit is enforced
- `group_cap_usd` (Number) USD allowed per source group per window (0 = uncapped)
- `user_cap_usd` (Number) USD allowed per user per window (0 = uncapped)
- `window_seconds` (Number) Reset frequency in seconds (minimum 60 when enabled)


<a id="nestedatt--token_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_limit`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the token limit is enforced
- `group_cap` (Number) Tokens allowed per source group per window (0 = uncapped)
- `user_cap` (Number) Tokens allowed per individual user per window (0 = uncapped)
- `window_seconds` (Number) Reset frequency in seconds (minimum 60 when enabled)
